SECURITY ADVISORY (5/5)                 
========================================
> UBUNTU USN                            
  Ubuntu/USN: Yodl DoS Flaw Patched     
                                        
  Canonical released advisory USN-9063-1
  resolving a buffer over-read in Yodl. 
  Crafted input can trigger an          
  application crash, causing a denial of
  service. Users should update installed
  packages now.                         
                                        
  Source: Ubuntu USN (Wed, 11 Nov 2026)
